accepted_claims: MC-ENG-OUTPUT/1.0 is the versioned current-tranche engineering-output profile for faithful nonempty, grouped, exact-zero-contact, singular/touching and empty machining states.
Canonical nominal material/certificate state and programme durable-body/lineage state remain authoritative; STEP geometry and kernel topology are derived outputs and may not define body identity.

Multiple disconnected bodies and exact-zero-contact bodies remain separate output solids/items with explicit manifest bindings; largest-body selection, tolerance fusion and positive bridge insertion are forbidden.

A singular or touching non-manifold durable body may use a certified finite grouped decomposition only when every piece is a certified subset, sibling interiors are disjoint, the certified union equals canonical material, and auxiliary seams are NON_MATERIAL_PARTITION rather than physical material boundaries.

EMPTY_MATERIAL is an explicit successful manifest-only output state with zero STEP artifacts/representation pieces while exhausted/disappeared durable-body lineage remains recorded; epsilon solids and placeholder nonempty STEP are forbidden.
MC-054 resolves the profile-decision portion of RB-016-04 and RB-016-05 while leaving those blockers open for their outstanding native/downstream evidence obligations.
open_claims: RB-016-01 through RB-016-05 remain open evidence obligations and are not closed by this profile decision.
XB-017-01 remains open because no source-bound BRL-CAD independent-consumer native execution has yet been run.

Grouped singular STEP, exact-zero-contact multi-body STEP, positive micro-feature preservation and manifest-only empty handling still require native and independent-consumer qualification under their existing downstream owners.
MC-B, MC-C, MC-D, MC-E, MC-F and MC-1 remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
adversarial_controls: reject STEP/kernel topology promoted to canonical body identity authority
reject omission of the mandatory output manifest
reject largest-body-only output or fused exact-zero-contact bodies
reject inserted positive bridges or tolerance healing at exact zero
reject grouped-decomposition pieces outside canonical material or overlapping in positive-volume interiors
reject auxiliary decomposition seams promoted to physical material boundaries
reject deletion of certified positive micro-material
reject EMPTY_MATERIAL represented by placeholder STEP, epsilon material or dropped exhausted lineage
reject closure of inherited blockers without the recorded native/consumer evidence
reject premature MC-C or programme capability promotion

review.disposition: completed versioned engineering-output profile decision; artifact dependents may consume the explicit material/body/empty semantics, while native and independent-consumer qualification remains open

downstream_invalidations: Any semantic change to MC-ENG-OUTPUT/1.0 requires a prospective versioned profile revision rather than silent reinterpretation.
Future native/consumer evidence may close only the matching open obligation and does not rewrite this task's non-execution record.

Any downstream repair, fusion, dropped component, tolerance-erased positive material, invented residual material or auxiliary-seam materialization fails the affected output claim rather than weakening the MC-1 denominator.
